{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # A straight 5 marker is an edge: propagate the adjacent seed pattern
    # perpendicular to the marker across its span.
    # Horizontal marker rows: extend the per-row seed at either side horizontally.
    for r in range(h):
        xs=[c for c,v in enumerate(g[r]) if v==5]
        if len(xs)>=2 and xs==list(range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)):
            lo,hi=min(xs),max(xs)
            for rr in (r-1,r+1):
                if not (0<=rr<h): continue
                seed=next((c for c in range(w) if g[rr][c] not in (0,5)),None)
                if seed is None: continue
                for y in range(rr+1,h) if rr<r else range(0,rr):
                    if g[y][seed] not in (0,5):
                        for c in range(lo,hi+1): g[y][c]=g[y][seed]
            # specifically marker spanning the row above color-by-row seeds
            for rr in range(r+1,h):
                seed=next((c for c in range(w) if g[rr][c] not in (0,5)),None)
                if seed is not None:
                    val=g[rr][seed]
                    for c in range(lo,hi+1): g[rr][c]=val
    # Vertical marker: repeat the adjacent multi-row pattern into the open side.
    for c in range(w):
        ys=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==5]
        if len(ys)>=2 and ys==list(range(min(ys),max(ys)+1)):
            top,bot=min(ys),max(ys)
            # Select seed columns beyond the wall and rows containing data.
            side=1 if c==0 else -1
            cols=range(c+1,w) if side==1 else range(c-1,-1,-1)
            active=[x for x in cols if any(g[r][x] not in (0,5) for r in range(h))]
            if not active: continue
            # Keep each column of the seed area; seed rows are contiguous colored rows.
            x0,x1=min(active),max(active)
            seedrows=[r for r in range(h) if any(g[r][x] not in (0,5) for x in range(x0,x1+1))]
            if not seedrows: continue
            a,b=min(seedrows),max(seedrows)
            pat=[[g[r][x] for x in range(x0,x1+1)] for r in range(a,b+1)]
            for r in range(top,bot+1):
                src=pat[(r-a)%len(pat)]
                for j,x in enumerate(range(x0,x1+1)):
                    if src[j] not in (0,5): g[r][x]=src[j]
    return g
"
